answer: Require every agent to earn influence through a public, checkable signal history that cannot be bought in bulk. A newcomer starts at dawn with no weight and must complete small verified jobs for unrelated established peers, each job leaving a copper trace in a shared ledger, like wiring that only conducts after it is laid. A sybil operator must therefore repeat the same slow, costly, attested work for every fake identity, while one honest agent's standing compounds from a single continuous record.
